message: The other day, I was reminded of how vital our family group chat can be during unexpected moments. We were getting ready for a storm, and while I was busy packing our go-bags, my husband was firing off questions in the chat: "Did we check the water? Where are the important documents?" It felt a bit chaotic at first, but it turned into a great way for us to stay organized and calm. I really appreciated how we could tackle it together, even if we weren't in the same room. How do you keep your family in the loop during these times?
